title: README + plugin correctness pass (handoff model, tool list, guard hook, skill routing)
description:
Docs + plugin correctness pass after README gap audit. 7 task granulari.

T1 Root README handoff: README.md "Handoff workflow" + "Core concepts" .planner/ tree sono STALE — documentano model file-based (.planner/HANDOFF.md canonical, prepare/show/clear). Reality: handoff entity-scoped (phase.handoff field), HANDOFF.md DEPRECATED (AGENTS.md §11), 5 tool (planner-handoff-list/show/write/clear/prepare), phase-scoped (handoff show <P00x>), auto-clear-on-done, delete-on-resume, archive .planner/handoff-archive/. Fix: rewrite handoff section + .planner tree (drop HANDOFF.md, add handoff-archive/).

T2 Root README tool list: README dice "32 public planner-* tools" (2x), actual 35. Missing: planner-phase-list, planner-task-list, planner-handoff-list. planner-export duplicato (Core + Export). Fix: add 3 *-list tool (Phases/Tasks/Handoff section), remove export dup, count 35, add phase/task list a slash-command section.

T3 Root README next prerelease: "Versioning & release" documenta solo pnpm release -> main. Repo usa attivo pnpm release:next (scripts/release-next.cjs) per next-dist-tag prerelease (npm 0.2.19-next.11). release-next.cjs NON bumpa plugin (plugin frozen 0.1.0, corretto ma non documentato). Fix: add "Prerelease (next) channel" subsection.

T4 plugins/claude-code/README.md: claim false "exposing planner-* AND plan_*/feature_*/phase_*/task_* tools" — solo planner-* esiste. Fix: "35 planner-* tools". Add nota write-guard (dopo G3=a: guard ORA inclusa nel plugin).

T5 plugins/README.md + plugins/_shared/README.md: sync script name wrong (scripts/sync-plugins.sh) -> scripts/sync-plugins.cjs / pnpm plugins:sync. plugins/README status claude-code "scaffold" -> "ready".

T6 G3=a: add PreToolUse write-guard hook al plugin. plugins/claude-code/hooks/hooks.json add PreToolUse matcher Edit|Write -> scripts/guard-pre-tool-use.sh. Script chiama npx -y agent-plan guard pre-tool-use (stdin pass-through). Add _shared/guard-pre-tool-use.sh.in template + sync target in scripts/sync-plugins.cjs. Aggiorna claude-code README "What it bundles" per includere il guard.

T7 G13: fix plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in routing -> planner-* MCP names (plan_init->planner-init, feature_list->planner-feature-list, phase_list->planner-phase-list, task_list->planner-task-list, feature_get->planner-feature-show, feature_create->planner-feature-add, phase_get->planner-phase-show, phase_create->planner-phase-add, task_get->planner-task-show, task_create->planner-task-add, plan_write_handoff->planner-handoff-write, planner-stop->planner-disable). Rimuovi route inesistenti (plan_render, project_update). Add route mancanti: repair->planner-repair, export/export-full->planner-export, handoff list/show/clear->planner-handoff-list/show/clear, bypass->planner-authorize-bypass, clear-bypass->planner-clear-bypass, disable->planner-disable. Re-sync via pnpm plugins:sync.

Comportamenti da preservare: plugin disabled-by-default, /planner load recap, SessionStart non-blocking, MCP server npx -y @agent-plan/mcp, sync derivation model.
